messages:
maria: opened PR to clarify rate limits, tiered quotas, and burst credit behavior; added an SDK quota-check example. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4123
kevin: quick skim looks good. avoid phrase 'unlimited burst' — use 'temporary burst allowance' instead.
sanjay: billing math on line 84 is wrong, double counted base tier. will paste corrected calc.
olivia: CI flagged a broken dashboard link under Usage analytics. docs-bot, which URL failed?
docs-bot: link-checker: broken link at line 110 -> https://console.redwood.ai/dashboards/old-metering-panel (404)
maria: replaced with https://console.redwood.ai/dashboards/metering-v2 and added note about panel name changes in migration guide.
lisa: can we include Python and Node quota-check one-liners for ops?
maria: added two short snippets: Python: from redwood import RedwoodClient; client = RedwoodClient(api_key=os.getenv('REDWOOD_KEY')); print(client.quota.check('acct_123').remaining_tokens)  Node: const R = require('@redwood/sdk'); const client = new R.Client(process.env.REDWOOD_KEY); client.quota.check('acct_123').then(r=>console.log(r.remaining_tokens))
kevin: add note about eventual consistency: quota endpoint may lag up to ~30s cross-region.
sanjay: corrected billing example: first 100k @ $0.004, next 400k @ $0.0025. 450k cost = 100k*0.004 + 350k*0.0025 = $400 + $875 = $1,275
olivia: two tiny grammar nits fixed.
maria: pushed fixes, included exported JSON snippet for new dashboard panel and a curl import example: curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" https://console.redwood.ai/api/v1/panels/import -d @metering-panel.json
lisa: approving once CI passes. thanks for handling link + math. :tada:
maria: merging after green CI. will mention wording change in release notes.
